name: PairVul
description: PairVul is a benchmark constructed for evaluating vulnerability detection in code snippets, supporting the assessment of LLM-based vulnerability detection techniques such as Vul-RAG that leverage retrieval-augmented generation and knowledge bases.
reputation: A relatively new vulnerability-detection benchmark that is mainly cited in recent LLM security and Vul-RAG work.
notes: Benchmark designed for vulnerability detection in code; supports evaluation of knowledge-augmented LLM methods.
